short: Direct-waveform GAN (M06) and speech-encoder perceptual loss (M02) are early but standard; the perceptual loss carries the words. Unseen-speaker WER 40.5% (successor 16%); no listener test.
position: The paper [@vougioukas2019video] changes two components, both standard on its evidence: waveform samples straight from a Wasserstein GAN (M06) and a perceptual loss through a pretrained speech encoder (M02). The perceptual loss carries the words: without it WER is 83.3%, near the 81% of random GRID slot choices (inference, for an ASR emitting only GRID words). Waveform output is not shown to help: a WORLD-vocoder system beat it on ESTOI within a year [@michelsanti2020vocoder], and its successor's gain came with new critics and losses (M06). Its unseen-speaker test goes beyond its cited priors, but 40.5% WER is not shown intelligible without a chance level or listeners. Evaluation (M12) is behind: "natural sounding" rests on no listener test.
